applies_to: separate idle-v1 control, serial after primary through shared lock
purpose: Measure resident CPU and retained memory when both image and video engines are loaded but no media job is executing
procedure: Fresh SDK, one image export and one Economy5s video export, then twenty 250ms no-op sleeps. Full cgroup CPU delta and per-operation kernel peaks; no runtime patches.
interpretation: Includes tiny IPC/measurement overhead; not an hourly VM bill, long-running soak test or memory-leak proof. Not pooled into primary medians.
